scenario.note: Assumed 8.2 psi / 34% O2, the NASA exploration-atmosphere point that bounds the challenge range.

scenario.note: Historical: pure O2 slightly above sea-level pressure (~16.7 psi).

cfig.title: Gaseous flames vs oxygen (ACME CFI-G, measured)
cfig.caveat: Burn time ends at self-extinction or when operators cut the fuel, and high-O2 tests used lower fuel flows to study cool flames. Treat as descriptive statistics, not a predictive model.

partial_gravity.method: u_b = sqrt(g * L * 0.8); flight tests whose forced-flow range contains u_b bracket the buoyant flow a flame of length L would induce. This is an engineering approximation, not a measurement.

gaps.title: Solid materials (fabrics, plastics) at lunar-habitat atmosphere
gaps.explanation: Every solid-material test with tabulated conditions in PSI is at cabin air. Fabric and plastic flame spread at >=30% O2 and ~70 kPa is the top-priority gap for Moon bases and rovers. Saffire-IV/V burned materials at exploration atmospheres, but those data are not yet in PSI; FM2 and LUCI are expected to add partial-gravity data.

gaps.title: Solid materials at reduced oxygen (fire-suppression by dilution)
gaps.explanation: BASS-II varied O2 below 21%, but per-test oxygen values are not in the PSI tables we could access.

gaps.title: Liquid fuels above 30% O2 at reduced pressure
gaps.explanation: Droplet data (FLEX) reach 34% O2 at 0.7 atm; lubricant or cleaning-fluid fires above that are unconstrained.

gaps.title: Gaseous flames at lunar-habitat atmosphere
gaps.explanation: ACME CFI-G provides spherical gas flames at 0.5 bar and 30-36% O2.

gaps.title: Any fuel between 22% and 30% O2 at reduced pressure (<80 kPa)
gaps.explanation: The transition band between ISS air and exploration atmospheres.

gaps.title: Pure-oxygen environments (suit / pre-breathe) at low pressure
gaps.explanation: No microgravity flammability data in 100% O2 at 4.3 psi in PSI, despite suit and airlock relevance (cf. Apollo 1).

validation.method: 5-fold stratified cross-validation with standardization fitted inside each fold; every prediction is made by a model that never saw that test.

recommendations.hardware: Large flow duct (Saffire heritage) or MSG flow duct (BASS heritage)
recommendations.rationale: Fabrics & textiles have 0 measured tests near the Lunar surface habitat atmosphere (30.0% O2, 70.3 kPa). Gravity there is partial, so a reduced-gravity platform (LUCI / FM2 class) is also needed.
